messages:
maya: Quick ask — Orchid customer saw big p99 spikes yesterday ~2024-11-03 14:20 UTC. Can someone drop links/queries for p50/p95/p99 + latency breakdown by model, route and sequence-length? Need quick slices for incident handoff.

dan: Start here: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/latency/overview — panel 12 has p50/p95/p99 times. For per-model breakdown use the "latency_by_model" dashboard (panel id 7).

dan: PromQL for p99 (example):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route, seq_len_bucket))
```

dan: Replace seq_len_bucket with the bucketing you want (0-64,65-256,256+).

irene: If you want traces: jaeger sample UI+filters: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=inference&tag=route:chat. Filter on traces where duration>1s and look for large decode spans.
irene: Quick curl to fetch one slow trace id from logs: `curl "https://logs.redwood.ai/api/v1/query?query=duration>1s%20AND%20customer=orchid"` then open in jaeger.

kyle: Re: alerts — current p99 alert lives in prometheus as rule "inference_p99_alert" (team:eng-oncall). It's firing a lot for seq_len 512+ on low-tier routes. I proposed raising the threshold to 1.2s for low-tier in https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerting/pull/421 — PTAL.

aditya: Short playbook snippet you can paste into the handoff message:
```
1) Open dashboard: grafana -> latency/overview (panel 12)
2) Change variable: model = <suspected-model>
3) Set seq_len_bucket = 256+
4) Inspect p50/p95/p99 over the incident window (14:00-14:30 UTC)
5) Jump to Jaeger -> filter service=inference route=<route> and duration>500ms
6) If p99 is concentrated on decode spans, escalate to eng-runtime
```

aditya: Also check the cache-hit-rate panel and batching-rate panel; low cache + low batch = higher per-token latency. Panel links: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/latency/cache-batch (panel 3)

sasha: Quick note: for customer-specific slices use `customer_id=orchid` in the Grafana query variable. Some dashboards default to prod-only aggregates, toggle to per-customer.

ops-bot: Incident #INC-2024-1123 created for Orchid spike; assigned to oncall/sre. Reminder: attach one example trace + top 3 slowest routes.

maya: Awesome, thanks. Can someone grab a trace + a screenshot of p99-by-model chart and paste here? I'll include in handoff to SRE. :thumbsup:

dan: Pasted trace id `fd2a1c3b` and screenshot -> https://img.redwood.ai/shot/3309876543-p99-model.png

irene: Link to jaeger trace view: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/trace/fd2a1c3b. Decode span shows blocking on KV fetch for large prompts.

kyle: If it's KV fetch spike, ops: can we check datastore latency metric? `sum(rate(datastore_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region)`

aditya: I'll add a short note to the runbook: if datastore latency >200ms for >5m and p99>1s, temporarily route to fallback-model to reduce tail latency. Filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/issues/88

sasha: One last thing — to reduce noisy page flooding, set the p95 alert to warning only, keep p99 as page. I'll open a small RFC in alerting repo.

maya: Perfect. I'll attach the two links + trace to the incident and handoff to SRE. Thanks everyone.
